name: Power Shot
body:
Your muscles ripple with magical energy when you pull back the string on your bow. With stunning force your arrow charges its way toward your target, awaiting to deliver a devastating blow.

Prerequisite(s): Str 15, 1st-level Arcane Archer

Benefit: Whenever you hit an enemy with an arrow, apply twice your strength bonus to the damage roll instead of the normal amount.
